Hi all — I reproduced this in staging when I submitted a US routing/account combination with a non-ASCII space accidentally pasted before the routing number. Coupa's validation returns a 422 when the payload includes control or invisible characters; our frontend currently passes the raw input without trimming or normalizing. Ben, flagging for infra: is there a recent change to payload sanitization that would affect production?

Alyssa — quick workaround: when entering bank data, try typing the numbers manually rather than pasting. If that doesn't help, go to the bottom of the banking step and use the CSV upload flow (we accept a simple two-column CSV: routing,account — Ben, can we share a template?).

We'll also push a short-term fix to strip control chars on submit; I'll confirm timeline in 1 hour. Attaching request logs from our proxy (coupa-422-logs.txt) that show the rejected JSON.

Rafael Mendes
